summary: Billing + Dealer Management feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_billing_dealers.py pass — admin login, /admin/dealers exposes fee_zar=50 & sla_hours=24 & billable_count/billable_total_zar on every row, /agreement/status returns accepted=false for fresh dealer + fee_zar/sla_hours, POST /submissions without agreement→409, POST /agreement/accept→200 stamps timestamp + status flips to accepted:true, POST /submissions without billing_accepted→400, valid submission→200 with billing_accepted_at stamped, POST /admin/dealers/{id}/active toggles active flag and login is blocked with 403 (message contains 'suspend') when inactive then re-enabled after reactivation, PATCH /admin/dealers/{id} updates phone (verified via /auth/me), empty PATCH body→400, PATCH email collision→409, POST /admin/dealers/{id}/password rotates the credential (old fails, new succeeds), GET /admin/submissions puts billable:boolean on every item, POST /admin/submissions/{id}/price + GET /admin/billing?month=YYYY-MM returns correct rows with amount_zar==billable_count*50, bad month string→400, /auth/me exposes active & agreement_accepted_at. Frontend mobile 390x844: fresh dealer login shows AgreementModal with title 'Fourbuy Pricing Agreement', R50 + '24 hours' terms, Decline & I Accept buttons — accepting closes modal and dealer lands on My Submissions. Submit screen renders correctly with Make/Model/Derivative/Mileage/Year/Colour/Warranty/Accident/Condition + 5 photo slots + red validation label before opening billing modal (verified). Admin mobile: Billing tab present in bottom bar, /billing screen shows 'R50 incl. VAT · SLA 24h', JULY 2026 label, PRICED/BILLABLE/TOTAL DUE cards (3/3/R150), 2 per-dealer rows (Test Dealer R100.00 · David Reid R50.00), billing-prev-month navigates to JUNE 2026 (PRICED 1 / BILLABLE 0 / R0.00) and billing-next-month returns to current month. Dealers tab: 5 dealer cards each with dealer-active-toggle-{id}, dealer-edit-{id}, dealer-reset-pw-{id}, remove-dealer-{id}. Edit modal opens with edit-first-name/last-name/phone/email/company-name/company-address + save/close testIDs — all fields visible and pre-filled. Desktop 1440x900: cockpit renders on admin login, header shows Submissions/Billing view switcher (both testIDs present), Submissions active by default with 3-way chips (admin-filter-incoming/priced/archived). Clicking cockpit-view-billing swaps entire body to BillingScreen (month nav + totals + rows), expanding a row reveals individual submissions FB-000001 Toyota Fortuner & FB-000002 BMW 3 Series each with cyan R50 badge (3 R50 badges rendered, 0 WAIVED — expected because all seed prices were within 24h). cockpit-view-submissions returns to the standard cockpit. No blocking bugs. Deprecated warnings noted (expo-notifications on web, shadow* style props) — non-blocking, pre-existing from iteration 6/7.

react_native_issues.issue: Dev warning on every route: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Non-blocking, already reported in iteration 6/7.

React Native Web deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking, already reported in iteration 6/7. New occurrences added by AgreementModal acceptBtn (AgreementModal.tsx:202-204) — consider migrating to boxShadow to silence future warnings, but functional.

action_items: No fixes required — backend (17/17) and frontend (mobile + desktop) all pass.
OPTIONAL cleanup (pre-existing): migrate expo-notifications web warning + shadow*→boxShadow across theme/components.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:70-83 is_billable() correctly guards against missing/naive priced_at and enforces 0<=delta<=24h — matches spec.
backend/server.py:388-396 create_submission enforces order agreement→billing_accepted; the 409 vs 400 distinction lets the client show the correct UX.
backend/server.py:635-641 PATCH dealer email correctly lower-cases + rejects collision with 409; skips update when email unchanged.
backend/server.py:717-740 GET /admin/billing uses [start,end) UTC window + status=='priced' query then filters priced_at inside window — no timezone drift bugs observed.
backend/server.py:775 rows sorted by billable_count desc — sensible default for admin.
frontend AgreementModal.tsx correctly gates on user.role==='dealer' && !agreement_accepted_at — will not show for admins or users with an accepted timestamp.
frontend submit.tsx handleSubmit() validates BEFORE opening billing modal; performSubmit() sends billing_accepted:true — wiring is correct.
frontend dealers.tsx uses window.prompt for reset password on web (spec allows this); mobile fallback should use Alert.prompt but is acceptable since dealer admin is primarily desktop.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mobile dealer + mobile admin + desktop admin all pass)

Screenshots at /tmp/agreement.png, /tmp/after_accept.png, /tmp/mob_billing.png, /tmp/mob_billing_prev.png, /tmp/mob_dealers.png, /tmp/mob_edit_modal.png, /tmp/desk_cockpit_submissions.png, /tmp/desk_cockpit_billing.png, /tmp/desk_cockpit_billing_expanded.png. Credentials: admin@fourbuy.co.za/admin123. To retest AgreementModal, register a fresh dealer via /api/auth/register — new dealers start with agreement_accepted_at=null. minitest@example.com has already accepted the agreement — reset via `db.users.updateOne({email:'minitest@example.com'},{$set:{agreement_accepted_at:null}})` in Mongo if needed.
